segments.speaker: Captain Pavel
segments.text: Dima. You are taking the Teilor Street case. Iris Vasilescu was found in her living room yesterday morning. The preliminary report cannot explain the injury as a simple fall. You are not being sent to tidy up someone else’s conclusion. Start with the room. The first examination is ready.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: It is me. I know you said not to do the rest of it by message. I am not trying to. Just tell me you are awake. You can be angry afterwards.

segments.speaker: Iris
segments.text: I finally moved the sofa. It turns out you can change a room without replacing everything in it. Do not let me make that into a statement for the wall. I mean the chairs can face each other now. That is all.

segments.speaker: Unknown voice
segments.text: She is settled now. She does not want an ambulance. Leave it until morning. I will keep the copy here.

segments.speaker: Iris
segments.text: You can keep it private. But you cannot keep calling it my choice.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: I cannot let them hear it like that.

segments.speaker: Iris
segments.text: Them, or me? We can say what we did without handing her whole life to strangers.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Then announce that the potatoes are ready. And stop both of you making that face at me.

segments.speaker: Elena
segments.text: Nobody can hear a face.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: I can.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Leave the light on. Your sister is still looking for the red button.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: I am not angry with you. I am trying to get the potatoes out before they turn to glue.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: I am sorry I said that. You do not have to take care of my feelings every time I get tired.

segments.speaker: Iris
segments.text: I keep trying to find the right version. There was a good evening. There was an argument. You were there. I was there. I do not want to choose which one gets to have happened.

segments.speaker: Mara Ionescu
segments.text: I was going to make coffee and realised I would ask how she took it. I have known her for sixteen years. There are apparently still ways for the morning to surprise you.

segments.speaker: Mara Ionescu
segments.text: We had a café with chairs so uncomfortable nobody could turn lunch into an entire business strategy. She once ordered a sandwich so large I was allowed to discuss structural integrity. I keep remembering her trying not to laugh with a mouth full of bread.

segments.speaker: Mara Ionescu
segments.text: A listening copy. Something Elena could leave playing without bracing for the next sentence. I understood that too well. Later I wanted people to think I had found it, not assembled it.

segments.speaker: Mara Ionescu
segments.text: Yes. She asked if I had kept the version before we made it kind. I said yes. It is a very small word to remember this often.

segments.speaker: Mara Ionescu
segments.text: Nobody made me type original instead of restored. When she stopped defending it, I thought she had abandoned what we made together. I did not ask if she was trying to come back to it honestly.

segments.speaker: Mara Ionescu
segments.text: I queued it after the rehearsal. The retry happened without me. Keep the capture and delivery fields separate, even if I wanted them to look simpler.

segments.speaker: Mara Ionescu
segments.text: I heard an adult saying she would stay. I needed that to mean someone was helping. I was not in the room. I did not hear a dispatcher.

segments.speaker: Elena Vasilescu
segments.text: I keep putting two cups out. Then I am furious with myself, as if it is a trick I am playing. You do not need that in your report. I just needed to say it somewhere.

segments.speaker: Elena Vasilescu
segments.text: There is a version I can listen to while I make tea. I know it is not the whole evening. I was there. I wanted one thing that did not make me wait for the argument.

segments.speaker: Elena Vasilescu
segments.text: We argued. I left. I do not have a sentence that makes those facts sound kinder. I thought we could do it tomorrow because she had asked me to keep the recipe cards.

segments.speaker: Elena Vasilescu
segments.text: She kept saying we could keep something without saying it happened exactly that way. I heard the first half as a promise and the second as her taking it back.

segments.speaker: Elena Vasilescu
segments.text: She had moved everything so we could look at each other. I thought she was preparing to win. I did not ask whether she was just trying to sit beside me.

segments.speaker: Elena Vasilescu
segments.text: The personal envelope was for me. That does not mean I am the audience for everyone else’s truth. I understand the distinction better now than I did then.

segments.speaker: Adrian Popescu
segments.text: I have already told the first officer we had an argument. I have the number if you need it. I do not want her family hearing three different versions of what I said.

segments.speaker: Adrian Popescu
segments.text: She wanted boxes. I told her I could bring them Saturday. We had said things like that before and then not done it. This time she had folded the blankets I kept there. So, yes.

segments.speaker: Adrian Popescu
segments.text: At the gathering? She was cold with me. Then she laughed at something Mara said and I was angry about that too. That is what I saw. I did not go back to the apartment. You can have the car records.

segments.speaker: Adrian Popescu
segments.text: The boxes were real. I was going to help. I was also hoping she would see them and change her mind. I do not know which part you want me to make sound better.

segments.speaker: Victor Neagu
segments.text: Before we start, I have sent the contract and the payment schedule. Originals, not a summary. I know how that sounds. There were six people waiting on that licence, Dima. I was trying to keep the work from disappearing. Yes, I put pressure on her.

segments.speaker: Victor Neagu
segments.text: The venue had a date. The crew had invoices. Every time Iris said wait, I had to call someone and tell them it was not their fault they would not be paid yet. I used that against her. It does not excuse it.

segments.speaker: Victor Neagu
segments.text: Home care. For my father. I put it through the production account because I had no money left in the other one. There. The provider can give you the hours and the name. My father does not know I did it that way.

segments.speaker: Victor Neagu
segments.text: That is the provider. CP-882. The original will match. I should have put the money back before anybody had to ask. Please keep my father’s details out of the public copy if they are not needed.

segments.speaker: Victor Neagu
segments.text: She wanted the meeting postponed. I told her everyone would be there anyway and we could sort it out afterwards. In front of guests, she was never going to make a scene. I knew that.

segments.speaker: Luca Marin
segments.text: You have the delivery number? Good. I can remember the case because one wheel pulled to the left. I took it to the receiving desk, got the signature and went back to work. If you need the route, I can draw it.

segments.speaker: Luca Marin
segments.text: It was my break. Forty-two minutes out, then I badged back in. People at work heard police and decided I had been sneaking off. I was allowed to leave. Please check the roster.

segments.speaker: Luca Marin
segments.text: Black case. Two wheels. Seal 0416. Heavy on the right when you picked it up. I did not open it, and nobody paid me to keep quiet about it.

segments.speaker: Luca Marin
segments.text: Julia signed there. I watched her write it because I had to take my copy back. Iris was by the other chair. After that I left. I cannot tell you what they did in the room.

segments.speaker: Luca Marin
segments.text: Those wheels, yes. The soles look like mine, but I am not the only person wearing work boots. Do you still need the boots? I have to tell my supervisor if I cannot use them.

segments.speaker: Julia Radu
segments.text: I have brought the receiving copy. There are two versions because the custodian does not keep the only record. Iris understood that. She was careful about it. May I see which copy you are using?

segments.speaker: Julia Radu
segments.text: The family original and the listening copy. Both. She was very clear. There is a difference between withdrawing a use and destroying its source. We agreed on that.

segments.speaker: Julia Radu
segments.text: I returned to the archive. It is in my statement. If you need a departure time, compare it with the register; I do not want to give you a convenient minute and find I have made a mistake.

segments.speaker: Julia Radu
segments.text: So the next person can see what was corrected. Otherwise they have to take your word for it. I teach this. I have taught it for a long time.

segments.speaker: Julia Radu
segments.text: She asked if two envelopes could be put together. Then she said that was precisely what she was trying to stop us doing. I understood the instruction. I have no good reason for pretending I did not.

segments.speaker: Julia Radu
segments.text: My batch number. Yes. I gave her that bookend long before any of this. That is not what you are asking, is it?

segments.speaker: Julia Radu
segments.text: Please leave the signed copy on the table. I know what the time says. I need a moment.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: I kept saying I never changed an original. As though that were the whole of what someone had asked me to do. She was trying to ask me to say it with both our names still there. I wanted to be the person who decided how it could be heard. When she would not let me, I hurt her. What I did afterwards was not the room misunderstanding me. It was me.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: To let the correction have both our names on it. I had imagined losing everything, and she was still making room for me inside an honest account. I could not hear that as anything except being exposed. That was my choice. She did not make it for me.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: Yes. I want to tell it as one terrible instant. The records will not let me. There was time afterwards. I used it to protect the account I wanted people to hear instead of getting her help.

segments.speaker: Julia
segments.text: You should not ask them to understand me. Tell them what you can establish. If there is something private she wanted returned, return it on her terms. I do not get to decide which part makes me easier to remember.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Leave the light on. Your sister is still looking for the red button.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: I am not angry with you. I am trying to get the potatoes out before they turn to glue.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Do not tell me I never listened. That is not fair. Stop the recorder for a minute.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: I am sorry I said that. You do not have to take care of my feelings every time I get tired.

segments.speaker: Elena Vasilescu
segments.text: The bit where she comes back and says sorry. I knew what came before it. I was in the room. Some mornings I could not get through that part again just to reach the apology. I wanted the copy. I did not ask anyone to tell strangers there had never been an argument.
